approval.basis: User continued the female day editorial product breakdown and GitHub upload workflow with minimal looks.

copy.captionKo: 차콜과 블랙 사이, 크림과 화이트의 얇은 틈.
copy.captionEn: Cream and white between charcoal and black.
copy.captionDe: Creme und Weiß zwischen Anthrazit und Schwarz.
copy.introKo: 차콜 재킷 안에 크림 니트와 화이트 셔츠를 겹쳐요. 칼라와 커프, 밑단에서 셔츠를 조금씩 보여주고 블랙 팬츠·삭스·로퍼로 아래를 길게 연결해요.
copy.introEn: Layer cream knit and a white shirt beneath charcoal tailoring. Reveal small edges of collar, cuff and hem, then continue black trousers into black socks and loafers.
copy.introDe: Schichte cremefarbenen Strick und ein weißes Hemd unter einen anthrazitfarbenen Blazer. Zeige kleine Partien von Kragen, Manschetten und Saum und verbinde schwarze Hose, Socken und Loafer.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 안쪽 레이어가 보이게 입어요. 소매와 밑단의 볼륨을 자연스럽게 남겨주세요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to reveal the inner layers, keeping the natural volume of sleeves and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit die inneren Lagen sichtbar bleiben, und lasse Ärmeln und Saum ihr natürliches Volumen.
products.altKo: 차콜 테일러드 재킷 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: charcoal dark grey wool-look hip-length tailored blazer, notched lapels, single-breasted dark front buttons, subtle welt/chest and lower flap pockets, relaxed straight silhouette

products.descriptionKo: 아우터 안에서 니트의 표면을 보여줘요. 밑단을 정돈해 와이드 하의의 여유를 살려요.
products.descriptionEn: Show the knit texture beneath the jacket and keep the hem neat above the wide trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige die Strickstruktur unter der Jacke und ordne den Saum über der weiten Hose.
products.altKo: 크림 크루넥 니트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: cream fine soft slightly fuzzy crewneck knit sweater, ribbed collar cuffs hem, full long sleeves conservatively reconstructed

products.descriptionKo: 니트 아래에 겹쳐 입고 칼라와 커프만 조금 드러내요. 몸판은 겉으로 부풀지 않게 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Layer beneath the knit, showing a little collar and cuff while keeping the body smooth.
products.descriptionDe: Trage das Hemd unter dem Strick und zeige etwas Kragen und Manschetten, während der Rumpf glatt bleibt.
products.altKo: 화이트 레이어 셔츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: white collared button shirt visible at collar cuffs and hem below cream knit, simple pointed collar and full long sleeves, hidden body plain conservative

products.descriptionKo: 넉넉한 통을 접거나 조이지 않고 자연스럽게 떨어뜨려요. 상의 밑단을 정돈해 하의의 실루엣을 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the generous legs fall naturally and keep the top hem neat so the trouser shape stays visible.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die weiten Beine natürlich fallen und ordne das Oberteil, damit die Form der Hose sichtbar bleibt.
products.altKo: 블랙 플리츠 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: black high-waisted tailored wide straight-leg pleated trousers, dark matte fabric, subtle front pleats and center crease

products.descriptionKo: 팬츠와 신발 사이에 리브 조직을 짧게 드러내요. 발목에 과하게 뭉치지 않게 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Show a short section of ribbing between trousers and shoes without excessive bunching.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige zwischen Hose und Schuhen etwas Rippstruktur, ohne die Socken stark zu stauchen.
products.altKo: 블랙 리브 삭스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair black ribbed crew socks, visible gathered ankle in reference, full hidden feet conservatively reconstructed

products.descriptionKo: 와이드 하의 아래 앞코와 솔이 드러나게 밑단 길이를 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Set the trouser length so the toe and sole remain visible beneath the wide leg.
products.descriptionDe: Wähle die Hosenlänge so, dass Spitze und Sohle unter dem weiten Bein sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 블랙 페니 로퍼 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair polished black leather-look penny loafers, rounded almond moc toes with apron stitching, black flat low heels and dark soles, classic penny straps

products.descriptionKo: 펜던트 없는 가는 체인을 크루넥 위에 짧게 걸쳐요. 셔츠 칼라와 겹치지 않게 위치를 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear the fine chain without a pendant just above the crew neck, keeping it clear of the shirt collar.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die feine Kette ohne Anhänger kurz über dem Rundhals und halte Abstand zum Hemdkragen.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 체인 네크리스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE delicate short gold-tone chain necklace without pendant, subtle small oval links as visible above cream knit, arranged full oval

products.descriptionKo: 작은 골드 톤 스터드로 마무리해요. 목걸이와 톤을 맞추고 크기는 작게 유지해요.
products.descriptionEn: Finish with tiny gold-tone studs, matching the necklace tone and keeping the scale small.
products.descriptionDe: Ergänze kleine goldfarbene Ohrstecker im Ton der Halskette.
products.altKo: 미니 골드 스터드 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair tiny plain gold-tone ball stud earrings from the small visible earlobe detail, hidden second earring and posts conservative, no other jewelry

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, linings, waistbands, shirt/sweater bodies and opposite footwear are conservative reconstructions.
Jewelry backs, posts and clasps are inferred; actual metal composition is unknown.
Material names describe visual appearance, not verified composition or performance.
Exact actual and feels-like temperature values are unknown; Chilly is grounded in the source folder.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, paper grocery bags and groceries are scene props, excluded from outfit products.
